The '''Aefao system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corosi sector/Legends|Corosi sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aefao]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Aefan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
